title: Finite-colimit preservation by the actual Kummer twist
statement: For a scheme X and integer m, the actual coefficient functor kummerModuleTwist X m, formed by sectionwise tensoring mu_m with a constant ULift(Z/m)-module and sheafifying, preserves finite colimits. No flatness or freeness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Coefficients; Stacks Project Tag 03EK, tensor product and sheafification.

proof.text: For each site object U, evaluating tensorLeft of the root module presheaf is definitionally evaluation followed by tensorLeft of the root module at U. The latter preserves colimits because the module category is monoidal closed. The pointwise criterion preservesColimits_of_evaluation gives colimit preservation by tensorLeft of the presheaf. The actual kummerModuleTwist is the composite of the constant-presheaf functor, that tensorLeft, and sheafification. Each preserves colimits, so the composite preserves finite colimits.
